CVE-2026-23865.title: An integer overflow in the tt_var_load_item_variation_store funct ...
CVE-2026-23865.description: An integer overflow in the tt_var_load_item_variation_store function of the Freetype library in versions 2.13.2 and 2.13.3 may allow for an out of bounds read operation when parsing HVAR/VVAR/MVAR tables in OpenType variable fonts. This issue is fixed in version 2.14.2.
